active_hint: Its webhooks, schedules and events start runs. Running it by hand works either way.

delete.body: Its versions and schedules go with it; its webhooks stop answering. Past runs stay until they expire.
delete.title: Delete this workflow?

description: Your workflows: what they do, their runs and versions.
edited: Imported. The file was edited after it was exported: check the program before turning it on.
not_found: This workflow does not exist, or it is not yours.

overview.webhooks_hint: Send a POST to the address with the header X-Webhook-Secret set to its secret; the body (JSON) is the run’s input.

package.empty: No workflows in it yet: import one from a file.
package.not_found: This package does not exist, or it is not yours.
package.workflows_hint: What it does, on or off

packages.description: Your packages: workflows that belong together.
packages.empty: No packages yet: install one from Explore, start a new one or import a workflow.
packages.title: Packages

run.bad_json: The input is not JSON: a value such as {"user": "ann"}, a number or "text".
run.input: Input (JSON, optional): what its first blocks get as input
run.title: Run now

runs.empty: No runs yet. Run it now, or turn it on for its triggers.
runs.no_result: Its result is no longer kept.

settings.delete_body: Its workflows go with it, with their versions, schedules and storage; their webhooks stop answering. Its published versions go too; packages others installed from it stay theirs.
settings.error_hint: It needs an ErrorTrigger block; its input says which workflow failed and why. Runs started by hand do not count.
settings.error_workflow: Workflow to start when an automatic run of one of them fails
settings.unpublished: Not published: only you see it. A version is what others read and install.

tags.label: Tags (up to 10): Enter or a comma adds one

title: Workflows

versions.restore_body: Its program becomes the current one, as a new version on top; nothing is lost, the current one stays in the history.

webhook.replace_body: The old secret stops working at once: whoever calls this webhook needs the new one. It is a change of the workflow, saved as a new version.

respond.ByBlock: The caller waits for a RespondToWebhook block and gets what it sends.
respond.Immediately: The caller gets 202 at once, with the run’s id; the run goes on.
respond.OnFinish: The caller waits for the run and gets its last block’s output (500 if it fails).
